proposal.description: Strike blink is taken from the half-period counter's MSB instead of from the toggled blink square wave, so the pattern repeats every half-period with an uneven duty cycle
proposal.reason: Whenever strikes are outstanding and no latch is present, Red_LED1 turns on and off at twice the intended rate and is lit for only part of each half-period (about 2.06 M of 6.25 M clocks at the default setting), instead of being a 50% square wave with period 2*LED_BLINK_HALF_CLKS.

proposal.description: Blink is toggled as the counter leaves zero, at the start of each half-period instead of at its terminal count, so the first half-period after reset lasts one clock
proposal.reason: After reset the blink phase is shifted by LED_BLINK_HALF_CLKS-1 clocks: if strikes are outstanding, Red_LED1 lights one clock after reset instead of a full half-period later, and every later edge of the strike blink comes early by that amount.

proposal.description: Blink timebase only counts while the converter is switching (S_SS or S_RUN), as if it shared the converter's enable, so it stops in S_OFF and S_HICCUP instead of running freely
proposal.reason: During the hiccup off-time strikes are outstanding but the converter is not switching. The counter freezes, so Red_LED1 stays at its last blink level, solid on or dark, for the whole hiccup instead of blinking.

proposal.description: Power-good LED is held dark during soft-start, as if the comparator could not be trusted until the ramp finishes, instead of following it in every state
proposal.reason: If the power-good comparator asserts while the supervisor is still in S_SS, pgood_LED stays dark until the converter enters S_RUN. It should light on the next clock.
